become.definition: An event in which the bearer changes from not satisfying the base state to satisfying it, under the same contextual interpretation. No causer, intention or method is specified.

cause_change.definition: An event in which agent causes patient to change from not satisfying the base state to satisfying it, under the same contextual interpretation. Intention and the means are not inferred. Instrument, when stated, is a means of this causing event.
